description: 행정안전부_자전거길 DB [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 국토종주 자전거길 13개에 대한 도로 위도 및 경도에 대한 정보를 제공하며 인증센터, 화장실, 급수대 등 국토종주 자전거길 주변에 있는 시설들에 대한 위치정보를 제공합니다. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
